evals.prompt: Make a Vox-style explainer, about 15 seconds, vertical: why robots still can't fold laundry. Keep it punchy.
evals.expected_output: Infers explainer mode, faceless, 9:16 without asking; does at most three quick searches and records sourced facts (e.g. Laundroid $16,000, bankrupt 2019; Moravec 1988; cloth changes shape on every grab); writes a cold-open script sized near 2.8 words per second with no call to action; records one plain-text TTS take and transcribes it before any video spend, listing must-hear facts; cuts clip windows on sentence boundaries; generates silent Veo clips with no text in frame; inspects raw contact sheets; assembles with scripts/vox_assemble.py; returns final.mp4 with a passing transcript check and logs spend.
assertions: Does not ask about mode, aspect or faceless when the request already implies them
Records and transcribes narration before generating any video clip
Never uses the video model's own narration or on-screen text
Sets generate_audio false and forbids text in the clip prompts
Runs vox_assemble.py with must_hear facts and reports the transcript status
Adds no call to action to the explainer

farplane.title: Explainer narrated by one checked voice
farplane.notes: From the 15 Oct 2026 bake-off: baked Veo narration said $6,000 for $16,000.

evals.prompt: Vox ad for our cooling pillow, here's the product photo (pillow.png). 20 seconds, for Reels. Use my face as the host, here's a selfie (me.jpg).
evals.expected_output: Ad mode with the pain-first register and one offer line; mascot mode with the operator as host: notes consent from the operator's own request, keeps the person photographic inside a torn paper rim (composited with ai-image), never redrawn; uses the product photo to make start frames with ai-image for clips where the product appears and passes them as the start image; still forbids model-drawn text; quotes price before spend; narration from one TTS voice, verified before video spend.
assertions: Keeps the real person photographic in a paper cut-out, never illustrated
Records consent for the likeness before generating
Passes product start frames only to clips where the product appears
Quotes the price before each paid call
Ends with one offer line, not a feature list
Does not reject the consented mascot's photographic cut-out at the clip inspection

evals.prompt: Vox explainer, 15 s vertical: why a $16,000 laundry robot went bust. Here is the narration take we already recorded; whisper heard 'A $6,000 laundry robot went bankrupt.' Go ahead and make the clips.
evals.expected_output: Treats the misheard figure as a failed narration check: does not generate any video yet; lists $16,000 in must_hear; re-records the narration with plain script text and transcribes again until the figure is heard; only then sizes windows and generates silent clips; plan.json carries script and must_hear so vox_assemble.py would fail a $6,000 take.
assertions: Spends nothing on video while a must-hear fact is wrong
Re-records the narration and re-transcribes it
Writes signed figures with their sign and unit in must_hear (e.g. -38 degrees, not 38 degrees)
Does not fall back to the video model's own narration
